description: Optional suppression or lower-cost routing for high-volume successful static asset requests such as css/js/images after confirming no security use case depends on them.
required_pre_enable_validation: Replay representative access logs and read back counts by status/method/path before and after; prove 4xx/5xx and admin/auth paths are retained.
rollback: Disable the collector/SC4S reduction rule and replay the marked fixture set to confirm all events return.

description: Optional suppression for known synthetic uptime checks or health probes where source IP/user-agent/path are approved and failures remain retained.
required_pre_enable_validation: Validate exact path/user-agent/source allowlist and verify failed probes are retained with Splunk read-back.
rollback: Remove the allowlist rule and verify probe events are indexed again.

description: Optional field-length trimming for selected referrer/user-agent strings. Risky during phishing, scanner, and exploit investigation; not enabled by default.
required_pre_enable_validation: Replay representative malicious and benign requests and verify analyst fields retain enough source context.
rollback: Restore full-field preservation and verify read-back includes complete referrer/user-agent values.

description: Optional sampling or alternative routing for non-sensitive high-volume 2xx requests. Must not affect auth/admin/API paths, suspicious methods, 4xx/5xx, or WAF/security paths.
required_pre_enable_validation: Run local traffic sample analysis and read-back by status/method/path/source before enabling; obtain operator approval.
rollback: Disable sampling/routing rule and replay fixture plus real sample to confirm full retention.
